name: SENTINEL
description: Autonomous Telemetry, Logistics and Analytics System

paragraphs: SENTINEL is an inspection triage platform built for the NextEra SPOT challenge at KnightHacks. It takes inspection data from Boston Dynamics Spot robots (through Orbit or direct uploads), checks each reading against a set of rules, and gives operators a short list of findings that actually need a human to look at them. It ships as a web dashboard, an iPhone app, and a FastAPI backend.
